errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents the model names
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis represents six different task/metric combinations (e.g., 'TriviaQA (EM)'), not the model names. The model names ('Flan-T5-783M' and 'GPT-4') are represented by the bar colors as shown in the legend.
The categories on the x-axis are not in alphabetical order ('TriviaQA', 'HotPotQA', '2Wiki').

The description incorrectly groups and concatenates the six distinct labels on the x-axis. The actual labels are 'TriviaQA (EM)', 'HotPotQA (EM)', '2Wiki (EM)', 'TriviaQA (F1)', 'HotPotQA (F1)', and '2Wiki (F1)'.
The vertical axis is not labeled in the figure. The label 'Score' is hallucinated.
The tick labels on the vertical axis are 25, 45, 65, and 85, which indicates an increment of 20, not 10.
This incorrectly assigns a single value to all blue bars. The value 77.1 corresponds to the red bar for 'TriviaQA (EM)', not a blue bar. The blue bar in that group has a value of 77.3.

errors.text_span: the red bars represent the GPT-4 Critic model, exhibiting a height of approximately 83.8
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous as it implies all red bars have a height of 83.8. In fact, only the tallest red bar (for 'TriviaQA (F1)') has this value.

errors.text_span: The shortest blue bar represents a score of 31.9
errors.evidence: The shortest blue bar is for 'HotPotQA (EM)' and has a value of 37.0. The value 31.9 corresponds to the red bar in that same group.

errors.text_span: the shortest red bar is placed at 53.3
errors.evidence: The shortest red bar is for 'HotPotQA (EM)' and has a value of 31.9. The value 53.3 corresponds to the blue bar for '2Wiki (F1)'.

The description fails to mention that the bars are grouped in pairs for each category on the x-axis. This grouped structure is a fundamental characteristic of the chart used to compare the two models for each task/metric.
